question: What, if anything, remains as a defensible contribution now that arxiv:2609.12230 already reports the full pipeline with positive results?
description: With arxiv:2609.12230 already publishing the full context-augmentation + adaptive repair + repair-before-RL pipeline (and positive results) on two biomedical disease KGs with synthetic multiple-choice QA, the original idea has no novel mechanism left. The remaining candidates are deltas rather than the idea: (i) a token-matched attribution test isolating passage coherence from context volume, (ii) transfer to open-answer, general-domain multi-hop benchmarks (MetaQA/WebQSP/CWQ/2WikiMultiHopQA) rather than synthetic biomedical MCQ, (iii) a rigorous negative/boundary result if context coherence does not survive a matched control, or (iv) dropping the idea and reporting substantial overlap. Which of these is worth pursuing, if any, is a direction decision.
rationale: The investigation must either identify a genuinely additive delta or record that the direction is fully covered; continuing to experiment on the original framing would only reproduce arxiv:2609.12230.
